elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 5.5 states that the Company owns all Deliverables and work product created for it.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly assigns all right, title and interest in the Deliverables and work product to the Company.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 5.5 expressly states that HDI retains its pre-existing intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The license to HDI intellectual property embedded in the Deliverables is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The license to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The license to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The Company retains all right, title and interest in Content and all customer, user and transaction data belonging to, supplied by or processed for it.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: The sole-purpose restriction is qualified by “except as the Company approves under Section 7.1,” permitting a broader HDI license if approved.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 5.5 expressly states that no intellectual property is owned jointly by the Parties.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: HDI retains only pre-existing intellectual property; there is no express reservation for generic tools or know-how, including those developed under the Agreement.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the Deliverables outright, and the necessary license to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the Deliverables outright, and the necessary license to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: Neither the assignment nor the embedded-HDI-IP license expressly states that the granted rights are worldwide.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the Deliverables outright, and the license covering embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Although the Company owns the assigned portions, the license to embedded HDI intellectual property permits only use and does not expressly permit modification.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The embedded-HDI-IP license contains no sublicensing right, so the Company cannot clearly sublicense the Deliverables as an integrated whole.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: The restriction contains an exception for uses approved by the Company under Section 7.1 and therefore is not limited solely to providing the services.
